stylingSolutions.solution: ffmpeg's own DOCUMENTED filter chains applied to the SAME real clip's verified bytes
reportedToWork: ffmpeg.org Filters Documentation — edgedetect: 'Detect and draw edges. The filter uses the Canny Edge Detection algorithm… Mix the colors to create a paint/cartoon effect' (the modes + the cartoon-effect mix are first-party documented)
superuser.com 'Make 3s sketch filter effect every minute in ffmpeg' (the sketch/edge recipe class)
zayne.io 'Creating Vintage Video Filters with FFmpeg' (the stylization-recipe class on real footage)
the repo's OWN seam already does filter_complex composition on real footage (packages/media-platform/src/ffmpeg.ts generateTestMp4 — overlay chains) — the adaptation point exists in-tree
stylingSolutions.adaptation: per-kind chains: tactical-look (green duotone via colorchannelmixer/eq + edge-line emphasis), 3D-game-look (palette/posterize quantization + saturation/sharpen boost), anime-npr-look (edge-outline + cel-quantization — the cartoon-effect mix)
